model_name: Agentium field-service knowledge ROI — modeled demo ROI
status: MODELED. These figures are produced by an editable assumption set, not measured at a customer. No assumption here is a benchmark, an industry figure, or evidence of expected Agentium performance. Replace every assumption with the evaluator's own numbers before any commercial use.
scope: One field-service organisation of a synthetic company (Nordvane Fluid Systems SA) using Agentium for grounded incident answers over procedures, service-level policies and spare-parts data.

benefit_1_search_time.label: Time saved locating procedure, policy and stock facts per incident
benefit_1_search_time.conservatism_note: Baseline of 22 minutes counts only document lookup, not travel or repair. The 35 percent reduction is a scenario assumption chosen for this synthetic model, not a benchmark and not an observed Agentium result. It is deliberately well below a full elimination of lookup time. Replace it with a figure the evaluator is willing to defend, then re-run the generator.

benefit_2_sla_credit_avoidance.label: Service credits avoided on P1 restoration commitments
benefit_2_sla_credit_avoidance.conservatism_note: Only one 12-hour credit block per avoided breach is counted, although SLA-PLATINUM-04 allows up to six. Only a quarter of existing breaches are assumed to be decision-latency breaches that better information can prevent.

benefit_3_expedited_freight_avoidance.label: Emergency freight avoided by checking regional stock before escalating
benefit_3_expedited_freight_avoidance.conservatism_note: Assumes only one expedited shipment in five is avoidable. Part cost itself is not counted as a benefit because the part is still consumed.

year_one_costs.conservatism_note: Year-one cost carries the full implementation charge with no amortisation, plus a full year of runtime and the customer's own project effort.

excluded_from_the_model: Revenue attributed to faster production restart at the customer plant.
Reduced technician turnover or onboarding cost.
Any benefit from Systems or Runs beyond the grounded-answer loop.
Any second-year benefit; the model is year one only.
